preconditions.description: The length of the original string s must be between 1 and 500,000.
The desired length of the string must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have a length equal to n and consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output string must have a length exactly equal to k.

postconditions.expression: stdout == min(s[:i] * (k // i) + s[:k % i] for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The output string must be the lexicographically smallest string of length k that can be obtained from s.
